name: doomsday-remedial
description: Doomsday value-collapse remediation: 6 az-league rotations with the default plan's az-league properties (exhaustive self-play matrix on the C++ actor, 50 games, 28 workers, rotating 20-cell vs-scripted slice, gate every 2 slots), but the expert demonstration shards are REPLACED: instead of the default roster-wide scripted:hard-vs-hard experts (whose doomsday games all LOSE, stamping z=-1 on every step of the combo line and reinforcing the collapsed doomsday value buckets), each rotation writes scripted:hard league/wubg_doomsday vs scripted:random opponents -- 100 matches with mirror_frac 0 = ~10 per roster matchup -- recording ONLY the doomsday seat, so the combo line's states enter the window priced by games the combo actually wins. mirror_frac 0 is safe here: the exhaustive self-play matrix ignores it, so it shapes only the expert opponent draw. Ends with a 10-game-per-matchup round-robin of the AZ net (az:gen) vs scripted:hard appended to baseline_report.log.
